overview:
The top 3 remains the same as last week, with Try Hard FC still in top spot and Yorkshire Lass UTD and Under my Cucurella in 2nd and 3rd places respectively. PurpleReina continued their climb up the table, displacing Shadechester FC in 4th place - however this was mainly due to Jade's team under-performing this week compared to other teams around them.

In fact, there was no real advantage gained at the top of the table this week, as the top 4 teams all scored within 2pts of each other. The average score this week was 48pts, however only 4 teams within League of Leg Ends scored below this points average.

Teams continued to select Haaland as captain this week despite not scoring in the previous 3 matches - however he ended his goal draught with a goal against Brighton in GW21 and scored a fairly adequate 6pts. While he wasn't the ideal captain choice this week, spare a thought for SmallTalkwithaSwede who opted for Jack Grealish as captain and doubled his score of -1pts after receiving a red card against Wolves.

We're well into January now and the winter transfer window. Popular FPL choice Semenyo is now a Man City player so it will be interesting to see how he will perform and how much game time he will get over the second half of the season. With rumours also floating around the likes of Guéhi, Rogers, Strand Larsen and Marmoush, it's certainly worth keeping a close eye on the ins and outs over the next few weeks.
totwDescription: Change Name edged out a narrow advantage over other teams this week, scoring 68pts and grabbing their first TOTW of the season. This was despite a red card and -3pts score for Cucurella. Being the only team to select POTW Harvey Barnes was a masterstroke, scoring 15pts for the team. There were also goals from Haaland and Thiago, an assist for Fernandes and clean sheets for Raya, Timber and Guéhi. Well done Alex 👏🏼
sackedDescription: After almost winning TOTW 2 weeks in a row, Pure Worship have reverted back to their default settings and are this week's lowest scoring team, with 25pts. Despite a goal for Fulham's Raúl Jiménez and a clean sheet for Arsenal's Gabriel, no other player scored more than 3pts. Doyle's team now find themselves at the bottom of the pack in 20th place.

otherUpdates.title: 👌🏻 Player of the Week
otherUpdates.content: Harvey Barnes (NEW ⚫⚪ - £6.1m) is this week's POTW, scoring 15pts after netting 2 goals against Leeds United in their 4-3 win. He has a low TSB% of 1.3% and is only selected by this week's TOTW Change Name within our league. Barnes is having a fairly mixed season so far this season, with 5 goals and 0 assists, and has only started 8 games for Newcastle.

otherUpdates.title: ⏭️ Next Gameweek
otherUpdates.content: The deadline for locking in teams, transfers and chips for GW22 is Saturday 17th January at 11am.
